high_level_description: The image shows a man and a young girl standing close together indoors. The man has light brown hair styled upwards and is wearing large black-rimmed glasses. He is dressed in a striped shirt over a white t-shirt and a necklace with a pendant. The young girl, who appears to be his daughter, has blonde hair tied back and is wearing a dark gray sweater. She is leaning her head on the man's shoulder, looking slightly away from the camera with a thoughtful expression.
